Research · master’s thesis

Digitalisation and structural transformation in ECOWAS economies

My thesis examines whether digital adoption is associated with industrialisation and more diversified exports. It covers fifteen ECOWAS countries from 2000 to 2023.

01

The starting question

I examine industry’s share of value added and export diversification. These two measures let me study changes in production as ICT use spreads across ECOWAS countries.

02

The approach

I use a panel of fifteen ECOWAS countries from 2000 to 2023. I construct the indicators and check for missing observations and breaks in the series. Diagnostics and estimates are run in Stata. The specification is still being reviewed.

03

Interpretation & limitations

Estimates of the relationship between ICT use, industry’s share and export diversification are under review, along with their robustness checks. I will report conclusions once the method has been validated. Observed associations alone do not establish a causal effect.

Work status

The master’s thesis is under review. The manuscript and final findings are not yet available. This overview explains the research question and the approach.
